title: Scaffold CSS partials and import them from main.jsx
acceptance: npm run build succeeds and ls src/styles/*.css | wc -l prints 8; src/main.jsx imports styles.css first, then the 8 partials in the order tokens, shell, nav, inspector, palette, overlays, screens, tiles.
notes: Creates every partial up front (header comment only) so later tasks never edit main.jsx or each other's CSS.

title: Guard hover rules with (hover: hover) and add a global focus-visible ring
acceptance: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('src/styles.css','utf8');const o=s.replace(/@media \(hover: hover\)[^{]*\{(?:[^{}]*\{[^{}]*\})*[^{}]*\}/g,'');process.exit(/:hover/.test(o)?1:0)" exits 0 (it exits 1 today with 18 matches); styles.css contains a :focus-visible rule using var(--focus-ring, ...); npm run build passes.
notes: Wrap the 18 :hover rules (styles.css lines 274-969). Keep input outline:none but add :focus-visible ring. Toast.jsx:15-16 onMouseEnter/Leave become pointer events that ignore pointerType touch. First of two serial styles.css writers (R1-10 is second).

title: Define shell, inspector, pastel-tile and cream-theme tokens
acceptance: npm run build passes; tokens.css defines --nav-rail-w:72px, --nav-side-w:220px, --tabbar-h, --inspector-w, --inspector-min, the z-index scale (--z-header 10, --z-nav 100, --z-fab 50, --z-sheet 200, --z-toast 300), --focus-ring, --hover, five --tile-* pastels for dark by default and for light under data-accent sky and cream, and a :root[data-accent="cream"] block with color-scheme: light; a comment records that cream --accent-solid vs #fff is >= 4.5:1 (use #c9382a) and --text-secondary on cream >= 4.5:1 (use #6f6580).
notes: Do not copy the blueprint cream values blindly: #ff6b57 on #fff6e9 is 2.62:1 and #82788f is 3.90:1. Tile tone is chosen by data-tone attribute, not nth-child.

title: Add a hash router, route table and useSubView hook with unit tests
acceptance: node --test test/router.test.js passes; tests cover parseHash/formatHash round-trip for #/today, #/life/tasks, #/logic/code, #/money/overview, #/invest/learn, #/agents, unknown paths falling back to #/today, and sub-view ids rejected when not in the table.
notes: Pure parse/format in routes.js (node-testable, no React). router.js exposes useRoute() via useSyncExternalStore on hashchange, navigate(path), and useSubView(tabId, defaultId) returning [view, setView]. Keep the API location-agnostic so a history-API swap is a one-file change.

title: Build command registry, command palette dialog and keyboard shortcuts
acceptance: node --test test/commands.test.js passes (registry register/unregister, fuzzy filter ranking, shortcut matcher for Cmd+K, Ctrl+K, Cmd+1..6, N, X, and ignoring keys typed in input/textarea/select); npm run build passes.
notes: Palette uses native <dialog> showModal like Sheet.jsx. Export useCommand(id, label, fn) so tabs register 'new' and 'complete' handlers later; tab wiring is done by the lane owners, not here.

title: Build container-query shell with bottom tabs, 72px rail and 220px sidebar
acceptance: npm run build passes; with the dev server, at widths 390, 700, 1100 and 1400 the nav is respectively bottom tabs, 72px rail, 220px sidebar, sidebar; 6 tabs fit at 375px without horizontal scroll; the nav has aria-label and aria-current="page" on the active item; Tab key shows a visible focus ring on every nav item.
notes: .app-root { container: app / inline-size; height: 100dvh } with an inner scroll pane (.page) so fixed-position behaviour inside the container cannot matter; resets page scrollTop on route change; Shell exposes slots for children, inspector and toast host. Does not edit App.jsx.

title: Make Sheet, Toast and FAB placement responsive via tokens
acceptance: npm run build passes; overlays.css has no 100vw and no literal 64px/80px bottom offsets; at <600 sheet is a bottom sheet with safe-area padding and max-height in dvh, at 600-1023 a centred modal max 520px, at >=1024 a right-side sheet; toast and FAB bottom offsets equal calc(var(--tabbar-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 12px) with --tabbar-h 0 when rail or sidebar is active; FAB hidden at >=1024.
notes: Overrides the legacy selectors .sheet-dialog, .toast-stack, .expense-fab (styles.css:620, 736, 829); the legacy copies are deleted later in R1-10. Sheet.jsx needs no change.

title: Add inspector pane primitive that falls back to a Sheet below 1024px
acceptance: npm run build passes; useInspector().open(node) renders the node in a right-hand pane when the container is wider than --inspector-min and in <Sheet> otherwise; Escape or close() empties it; pane scrolls independently and has a labelled region role.
notes: Domain-screen adoption (Life tasks, Money txns, etc.) belongs to the lane agents' tasks.

title: Wire shell and routes into App.jsx with Home as first and default tab
acceptance: npm run build passes; opening / redirects to #/today and shows the Home stub; #/life/tasks, #/logic/code, #/money/overview, #/invest/learn and #/agents open the matching tab; TABS lists Home, Life, Logic, Money, Invest, Agents in that order; KEY_TO_TAB accepts arrays so a remote 'tasks' change bumps both Life and Home ticks; THEMES includes cream; document theme-color meta is updated on theme change.
notes: New tab id is Home (label Today) because id Today is already used for the Codeforces progress key (App.jsx:36, LogicBuilding.jsx:42,82). Replaces tab useState (App.jsx:51), TABS (15-21), render block (278-301); mounts CommandPalette and shortcuts. Auth/loading/error screens keep the .app wrapper. Any later task that edits App.jsx must dep on this.

title: Migrate legacy styles.css to tokens and remove the old tab bar and 640px shell
acceptance: npm run build passes; styles.css no longer contains .tab-bar, .tab-bar-inner, .tab-btn, the sticky .app-header rule, .content padding-bottom:100px, or the legacy .toast-stack/.expense-fab/.sheet-dialog positioning; .app keeps only the auth-screen centring (max-width allowed there); .puzzle-card, the title gradient, send-btn hover and fab hover shadow use theme tokens so they render correctly under data-accent sky and cream.
notes: Second serial writer of styles.css (after R1-02). Sky glass rules at styles.css:75-92 move to tokens (--nav-bg) rather than being deleted.

title: Add wide-pane CSS for legacy single-column blocks
acceptance: npm run build passes; at container width >=600 the .page content has a max-width token, .stat-row/.life-stats keep equal columns, .expense-cat-grid goes to 6 columns, .chat-bubble max-width is 70ch; no change below 600px (390px screenshot identical).
notes: CSS only, selectors from styles.css:214, 710, 996, 515. Inline grids in Expenses.jsx:451,1139 are left alone.

title: Adopt useSubView in Life, Logic, Money and Invest tabs
acceptance: npm run build passes; loading #/life/habits opens Habits, #/money/loans opens Loans, #/logic/exams opens Exams, #/invest/watch opens Watchlist; clicking an agent-pill changes the hash; browser Back returns to the previous sub-view.
notes: One-line replacement of useState at Life.jsx:80, LogicBuilding.jsx:20, Expenses.jsx:106, Invest.jsx:27. Hot spot: schedule in a wave where no other task writes these files. Life keeps its group derivation (Life.jsx:43).

title: Add static CSS guard test for shell and input-model rules
acceptance: node --test test/shellCss.test.js passes and fails if any of these regress: a :hover rule outside @media (hover: hover) in any src CSS file, a 100vw or calc(64px + ...) literal, a missing @container app (min-width:600px) or (min-width:1024px) block, a missing :focus-visible rule, or a missing data-accent="cream" block.
notes: Cheap regression net until R7 adds Playwright viewport tests.
